# shibumistack.dev

> A small web stack: Bun, Hono, Zod, Drizzle, SQLite, Alpine, and Nanostores. Clear seams. No hidden runtime.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.md)
- [Roadmap](/building.md)
- [shibumi-server](/server.md)
- [DX plan](/dx.md)
- [Brand](/brand.md)

## In development

- [`shibumi-server`](/server.md): an open-source Bun service for signed GitHub webhook deploys to rootless Podman behind Caddy, with host preflight, bounded builds, health checks, and two retained rollback images. Public templates contain no machine credentials; real configuration and secrets stay on the VPS.
